question: The popular folk dance of Bihar, which represents the love and quarrel of a married couple, is called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jat-Jatin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Jat-Jatin** is a popular folk dance of Bihar, often performed during the monsoon season.
 
• The dance is a symbolic representation of the **love and quarrels of a married couple**, portraying their emotional dynamics.
 
• It is widely performed in the Mithila region of Bihar and adjoining areas, showcasing the cultural richness of the state.
 
• The dance is accompanied by traditional folk songs that narrate the stories of **Jat (husband) and Jatin (wife)**.
 
• Jat-Jatin serves as a form of entertainment and a medium for expressing the daily lives and struggles of rural communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Folk Dances of Bihar:**

 
 
• Some other famous folk dances of Bihar include **Sohar-Khilouna, Bidesia, Jhijhiya, and Kajari.**
 
• These dances are deeply rooted in the traditions and practices of rural Bihar, celebrating various aspects of life.
 
 
 
• **Mithila Region:**
 
 
• The Mithila region is known for its unique cultural heritage, including **folk art, music, and dance**.
 
• It is also famous for the world-renowned **Madhubani paintings**.
 
 
 
• **Music in Jat-Jatin:**
 
 
• The music accompanying the Jat-Jatin dance typically uses traditional instruments such as **dholak, harmonium, and manjira**.
 
• The lyrics focus on themes of rural life, love, and hardships faced by couples.
 
 
 
• **Cultural Significance:**
 
 
• Jat-Jatin reflects the social and emotional aspects of relationships in rural Bihar.
 
• It provides insights into the challenges faced by couples due to migration, poverty, and societal norms.
